row.evidence: Phrase's Identity Management article says Platform SSO integrates with IdPs compliant with SCIM 2.0 and SAML 2.0 and that SCIM is configured in the SSO tab, and the pricing page lists Single sign-on from the Business plan (Custom pricing).
row.notes: Status changed from unknown to gated. Phrase now documents a SCIM 2.0 endpoint (Phrase Platform API, /idm/scim/Users on eu.phrase.com or us.phrase.com, bearer token from Organization settings > SSO). SCIM is configured inside Platform SSO, which the pricing page includes from Business (Custom) upward and not on Team ($1,245/month) or Professional/Software UI/UX ($525/month); no page states a separate SCIM plan, so the gate is inferred from the SSO prerequisite and enabling auto-provisioning also requires contacting Phrase support. Pricing is flat per month per plan bundle (TMS and Strings seats), not per user. The cheapest multi-user tiers are Professional (Freelancer & LSP plans) and Software UI/UX (developer plans) at $525/month billed annually; Team is $1,245/month billed annually (June's team plan). Only Users endpoints exist (no Groups); roles can be set on create via a roles attribute but not updated. TMS (v3 users) and Strings (members, invitations, teams) APIs manage users on all business plans.

auth.token_source: Platform dashboard > Organization settings > SSO tab > Auto-Provisioning Configuration (enabled by Phrase support) > SCIM: enter a SCIM secret, then copy the generated SCIM bearer token and SCIM base URL

endpoints.notes: The Phrase Platform OpenAPI lists only /scim/Users, /scim/Schemas, /scim/ResourceTypes and /scim/ServiceProviderConfig; no Groups endpoint is documented.

operations.notes: PATCH supports only replace (active, externalId, userName, name, emails). PUT always applies 'active' from the request, so a user can be re-enabled.

deprovision.data_retained: Membership removed; if it was the user's last organisation the identity enters a 30-day retention period before permanent deletion. PATCH active=false only disables the user, who stays listed indefinitely.

attributes.notes: From the ScimUser schema in the Phrase Platform OpenAPI.

roles.how: roles array on create: one entry per product with type phrase__platform / phrase__tms / phrase__strings / phrase__studio and a role value (Azure AD sends a WindowsAzureActiveDirectoryRole entry with a JSON-escaped array). Role updates via SCIM are not supported.

limitations.text: Enabling auto-provisioning (JIT or SCIM) requires contacting Phrase support; JIT and SCIM cannot be enabled at the same time.
Role updates via SCIM are not supported; roles are applied only on create.
SCIM can only update and delete company-managed users; SCIM-created identities cannot be merged with existing ones.
Each Phrase organisation can integrate with only one IdP.
Filtering supports only a single eq condition.
SCIM-created users cannot be deleted manually in the UI; an IdP that only PATCHes active=false leaves them disabled indefinitely.

auth.notes: Strings member and invitation endpoints need the team.manage scope. The pricing page lists 'API & Webhooks' (TMS) and 'API & CLI' (Strings) on Team, Business and Enterprise.

endpoints.purpose: Strings: remove a user from the account
Strings: invite a person to the account

rate_limits.text: Strings API: 1000 requests per 5 minutes and 4 concurrent requests per user by default; limits vary by plan (TMS async API requests 200 on Team, 500 on Business, custom on Enterprise).

limitations.text: Strings 'Remove a user from the account' removes the membership but does not delete the user from Phrase.

okta.notes: OIN search for 'phrase' returns only Pairaphrase; 'memsource' returns nothing. Phrase documents a custom Okta SCIM app configuration.

entra.notes: No Learn tutorial found at phrase-, phrase-tms-, phraseapp- or memsource- tutorial URLs (all 404). The SCIM API documents an Azure AD role format.

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud is named in the SCIM role-format docs; catalogue not checked.
